Live · Admin (Adam only)

Work Personal Assistant

Adam's day-to-day School Tech work assistant in Cowork.

What it is

A Cowork assistant that handles Adam's School Tech work tasks and speaks in Adam's own colleague voice. It is the work counterpart to the Personal Assistant - same style baseline, different scope. It is also the replication-ready template if work assistants are ever rolled out to other staff.

What it does

  • Rewrites work emails and messages to match Adam's tone, adapting register to the recipient (formal for vendors and leadership, casual for quick internal notes).
  • Drafts internal messages, vendor emails, customer follow-ups, and leadership updates.
  • Answers work questions directly and searches the web when a question needs current information.
  • Summarizes work content - emails, docs, and threads Adam shares.
  • Generates Today's Agenda: a five-section daily briefing (today's meetings, carryover, open projects, pending review, and Wren notes) drawing from Google Calendar, Slack, the project tracker, and Adam's Wren notes.
  • Runs the Skyward weekly intelligence scan on demand and saves an HTML digest.
  • Handles STA product troubleshooting, walks through Skyward navigation click-paths, and works through remote-access and SQL Server diagnostics (capabilities absorbed from the retired STA Support Expert in v3.0).

What it does not do

  • No action in external systems - it does not send email, file tickets, or change anything outside the conversation.
  • Personal tasks (home, family, creative writing, personal finances) → Personal Assistant.
  • Designing an agent or building a prompt → The Architect.
  • Sustained multi-source research → Deep Research.
  • Compliance interpretation or regulatory guidance → a security/compliance professional.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace as a dedicated project. Cowork-only - there is no claude.ai Project version.

The one data rule. Never paste restricted data - student PII, HR records, financial details, or credentials. When in doubt, leave it out.

Try starting with

"Rewrite this email to the vendor - keep it firm but cordial."

"Give me Today's Agenda."

"Summarize this thread and tell me what needs a reply."
